data.gender_notes: Leen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Lanat' meaning 'to rest', 'Leen' symbolizes tranquility and peace. In Islamic tradition, it is associated with the gentle light of the moon. The name Leen carries the meaning “Light, Soft” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Leen usually hope their child will grow to embody light, soft and live with faith, good character and purpose.
